descriptions.introduction: Self-host Hyvor Relay, an open-source alternative to AWS SES, Mailgun, and SendGrid. Learn about its architecture, licensing, and security.
descriptions.deployEasy: Deploy Hyvor Relay on a single server with Docker Compose. Prerequisites, installation, and configuration for small to medium sending volumes.
descriptions.deploy: Deploy Hyvor Relay for production on multiple servers with Docker Swarm, for high availability and large sending volumes.
descriptions.setup: Set up a self-hosted Hyvor Relay instance: web domain, Sudo access, instance domain, PTR records, health checks, and NAT configuration.
descriptions.management: Manage a self-hosted Hyvor Relay instance: the system project, sudo users, and IP warmup.
descriptions.monitoring: Monitor Hyvor Relay with Prometheus metrics, a pre-configured Grafana dashboard, Alertmanager alerts, logs, and uptime checks.
descriptions.scaling: Scale a self-hosted Hyvor Relay instance for higher sending volumes, from Postgres max connections to example server setups.
descriptions.upgrade010: Upgrade a self-hosted Hyvor Relay instance to 0.1.0, which stores email contents in a Docker volume or an S3-compatible bucket.
descriptions.healthChecks: Hyvor Relay runs built-in health checks every hour. See what each check verifies and how to fix issues on your self-hosted instance.
descriptions.dns: Hyvor Relay's built-in DNS server for the instance domain: the default records it serves and how to add custom DNS records.
descriptions.deliverability: Improve email deliverability on a self-hosted Hyvor Relay instance: content, technical configuration, IP reputation, blacklists, and tools.
descriptions.providers: Sending to major email providers from Hyvor Relay: feedback loops (FBLs) and the enhanced SMTP response codes providers use.
descriptions.fblYahoo: Enroll your Hyvor Relay instance domain in Yahoo's Complaint Feedback Loop to receive spam complaints and suppress recipients automatically.
descriptions.fblMicrosoft: Receive spam complaints from Outlook and Hotmail for your Hyvor Relay instance by joining Microsoft's feedback loop programs.
descriptions.env: All environment variables for configuring a self-hosted Hyvor Relay instance, with defaults and examples.
